scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducible finite checks supplied; no external independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The all-tree claim concerns ordinary finite undirected trees of order at least three, not general graphs.
The known maximum edge-general-position number and the existing spider-tree special case are excluded from novelty.
Finite enumerations corroborate rather than establish the unrestricted theorem.
Publication priority against unindexed equivalent results remains uncertain.
title: Maximal edge-general-position sets of trees: saturated subtrees and the lower number
